question: President of India, Droupadi Murmu met President of Republic of Suriname, ______ on the sidelines of the 17th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention at Indore, Madhya Pradesh on 10 January 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandrikapersad Santokhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Suriname President Chandrikapersad Santokhi on January 07 arrived at Indira Gandhi International Airport in New Delhi.
 
• Mr. Santokhi is on a 7-day visit to India from January 7 to 14.
 
• He will be the **Special Guest** of Honour at the **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) Convention 2023** in **Madhya Pradesh's** **Indore**.
 
• On January 9, he will attend the inaugural session of the 17th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention 2023 in Madhya Pradesh's Indore.
 
• He will also attend the valedictory session and the Pravasi Bharatiya Samman awards ceremony on January 11.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD)** provides an important platform to engage and connect with overseas Indians and to enable the diaspora to interact with each other.
 
• The** 17th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention** is being organized in partnership with the **Madhya Pradesh government** from January 8-10 in Indore.
 
• The theme of this PBD Convention is "Diaspora: Reliable Partners for India's Progress in Amrit Kaal."
 
• Over 3,500 diaspora members from around 70 countries have registered for the PBD Convention.
